children: An entity controlled by Indonesian tycoon Haji Isam, whose real name is Andi Syamsuddin Arsyad, has offered about $3 billion in cash for a 62% stake in coal miner Bayan Resources
, Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
The offer values Jakarta-based Bayan at a fraction of its market value and is for a stake held mainly by billionaire Low Tuck Kwong and his daughter Elaine, the report said.
Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
